nodes.description: The only curative treatment. Outcomes in the few transplanted patients are mixed: one cousin with the truncating allele was infection-free and at school 4.5 years after transplant despite only 20% donor chimerism, while her cousin died of septic shock 20 days after transplant. Both p.P440S siblings were transplanted at age 6 and one died of pneumonia on day +102, so two of the four transplanted patients described here died. General SCID transplant cohorts show better survival with early transplant and no active infection.

nodes.description: With partial LCK function (p.P440S), conventional T cells can mature but regulatory T cells cannot. In mice, Treg numbers are reduced in both the knockout and the P440S knock-in; what sets P440S apart is that conventional T cells keep enough function to cause disease once Treg number and function are deficient. The published human cases disagree on Treg numbers: IUIS lists low Treg, while the complete-loss p.C465R patient had an increased Treg percentage among a reduced T-cell pool, so this node is supported for the hypomorphic allele rather than for the disease as a whole.
